content.short: Startup finance platform with treasury and spend/accounting features.
content.description: Arc is a US-based financial platform built for startups, giving founders and finance teams a single place to bank, borrow, and manage cash. It offers business accounts with treasury and yield on idle balances, working-capital and venture-debt style funding, corporate cards, bill pay, and spend controls, alongside tools that connect to accounting workflows. By combining banking, financing, and cash management for technology companies, Arc aims to replace the mix of traditional banks, brokerages, and lenders that early-stage teams typically stitch together. Its focus on startup treasury and payments makes reconciliation and finance operations a core part of the product experience.
